lines.text: See a GP if you have a persistent red or scaly patch of skin and do not know the cause.
It's important to get a proper diagnosis, as Bowen's disease can look like other conditions, such as psoriasis or eczema.
If necessary, your GP will refer you to a skin specialist (dermatologist) to determine what the problem is.
If they are not sure about the cause, they may need to remove a small sample of skin so it can be looked at more closely (a biopsy).
